about_the_game:
The Land Beckons

The Brave Answer

Giona, province of Caspena - the land of adventure and opportunity! Champions of all kinds gather here. Now, after over 100 years of peace a new storm is brewing and you are the only one who can prevent it. You are... the Shopkeeper.

Join the brave Champions on their journey in this pixel-art Medieval-Fantasy Weapon Store simulator to keep Giona safe by providing the services and arming them for their quests. However, customers depend on your expertise, so listen to their stories, use the information they provide, and consult the notes in your Adventure Codex to deduct their needs and choose the weapon that suits them best. Every client is a riddle for you to solve. 

Deal with the customers: help some eccentric ones solve their unusual problems or turn them away in the branching story. Sell weapons day after day to make your store into the most renowned of all, and make sure the Adventurers are prepared for what is yet to come...

To answer What Makes a Hero you will:

  • Open your weapon shop and serve adventurers with their unique needs and tales to share

  • Use your Adventure Codex to piece together what type of weapon they prefer

  • Decide whether to help them, make a deal, or kick them out

  • Solve puzzles within the interactions and be prepared for various outcomes

  • Help some more eccentric customers with their unusual problems

  • Gather and trade items to make your store prosper day after day

  • Make many impactful decisions that will shape Giona's fate

  • Or replay it to reach different outcomes

  • Live the heroic fantasy seen from a different angle

  • Build your renown and become the greatest Shopkeeper in the land of Theos

  • Help Champions become strong enough to be prepared for the darkness looming on the horizon
